page.overview:
Who is Hand Demon?

The |Te Oni}} is the primary antagonist of the Final Selection Arc of Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba. He was a notorious demon who killed thirteen of Sakonji Urokodaki's apprentices, including Sabito and Makomo, as well as at least fifty other would-be Demon Slayers.

The Hand Demon was a monstrously large, veiny, hulking monster distinguished by olive-green skin, blood-red fingernails, and beady yellow eyes with cross-hatched pupils. After devouring fifty humans, he lost his original humanoid appearance, growing massively in size and gaining a wide mouth filled with jagged teeth. The Hand Demon acquired so many arms that he was forced to discard his clothing, using his limbs to cover his body instead, and abandon bipedal movement to crawl on all hands like an animal.

The Hand Demon was ruthless in his treatment of humans, immediately killing them and even attacking the ones who fled. He bore a great hatred for Sakonji Urokodaki, cursing him for defeating and trapping him in the wisteria-riddled Mount Fujikasane, and vowing to kill all of his apprentices for revenge. He was also very sadistic, gleefully explaining his murder of Sabito and Makomo to Tanjiro Kamado. Despite this, the Hand Demon had a deep fear of death, being too afraid to close his eyes after Tanjiro beheaded him.

When he was human, he had a habit of asking his older brother to hold his hand, a trait which made his sibling label him a scaredy-cat. In his final moments, the Hand Demon extended a hand to Tanjiro for him to hold, shedding tears of gratitude when his request was granted.
